title: spring.cassandra
description: Two buckets: spring.cassandra.default holds family-wide values (each overridable per instance), spring.cassandra.instances.<name> holds one entry per named instance. No other key belongs directly under spring.cassandra.

default.description: Family-wide values, each overridable by an instance.

driver.description: Names the Driver bean that assembles every instance's transport unless an instance names its own. Empty injects the single Driver bean by type; naming a missing bean fails startup.

instances.description: One entry per instance; the key is the bean name, and any name is legal.

hosts.description: initial contact points; entries may carry a port ('host:9042')

username.description: PasswordAuthenticator user; must be set together with password
